leave: Full-time employees receive 20 vacation days each calendar year. Vacation days are requested in the people portal at least two weeks ahead, and the employee's manager approves them. Up to five unused vacation days carry over into the next year; any others expire on the last day of December.
expenses: Employees may claim travel and equipment costs that have a business purpose. Any expense above 200 dollars needs written approval from a manager before the purchase is made. Submit receipts in the finance portal within 30 days of the purchase, or the expense will not be reimbursed.
equipment: Every employee receives a company laptop on the first day. The laptop must be encrypted and locked whenever it is left unattended. When an employee leaves the company, the laptop and its charger are returned to the IT desk on the last working day.
